scores.rationale: Thorough, calibrated, and highly actionable, but drastically overlong and repetitive; some narrative linkage and account-compromise conclusions exceed the direct evidence.

Client-usable structure and a suitably explicit narrow-scope theory, though it overstates hostname-inferred server roles, credential compromise, operator intent, and causal linkage at HIGH confidence.

why: It delivers nearly the same investigative value with far better focus and readability, making it the stronger client-facing report despite several confidence-calibration defects.
